views.label: mansion-full-third-floor-slab-roof
views.notes: Three complete storeys; continuous oak slab roof with clean stepped edges and no holes.

views.label: mansion-foyer-raised-floor-connection
views.notes: Connected stair landing, continuous carpet border and clear headroom.

views.label: mansion-revised-cellar
views.notes: Wide enclosed hall with regular lantern rows and open side doorways.

views.label: mansion-oak-posts-and-carpet-corners
views.notes: Oak posts and white/red carpet render cleanly. This close view shows a straight border; diagonal corner adjacency is covered by structure checks.

views.label: mansion-authored-mushrooms-and-mines
views.notes: Authored mushroom plot, contained water, adjacent side openings and twin mineshaft openings render correctly.

views.label: mansion-authored-pens
views.notes: Cow pen retains hay and water, with a gated connection to the neighboring chicken pen.

views.label: yak-native-donkey-panniers
views.notes: Side-by-side native donkey and yak show matching chest shape, atlas and scale; chest is attached flush to yak torso.

views.label: fiddler-native-purple
views.notes: Former purple variant has an orange shell matching legs; underside is visibly connected rather than sand-colored.

views.label: fiddler-native-red
views.notes: Former reddish variant uses the same warm shell/underside as its legs; blue control variant remains blue.

views.label: desert-cut-stone-natural-rim
views.notes: Visible entrance is stone only along the excavated hollow; surrounding orange/brown terracotta slopes and natural rim remain intact.

views.label: camp_overhead
views.notes: Square camp, nine widely spaced tents, continuous crop belt, podzol road margins, paired perimeter pens and broad inner/outer roads are visible.

views.label: camp_pens
views.notes: Large fenced grass pens with centered square ponds and hay; roads separate pens from crops and palisade. Live animals are inside the pens.

views.label: camp-twelve-row-crops-and-submerged-cane
views.notes: Ordered crop strips and repeated four-square water ponds render correctly with cane entirely submerged; tent approaches and podzol margins stay clear.

views.label: camp_gate
views.notes: Native log gate decoration retained, wide continuous path runs into the camp, and adjacent palisade and pen joins are clean.

views.label: rainforest-final-bamboo
views.notes: Bamboo rises from the green forest floor and stops beneath solid logs/leaves. Cherry foliage and moved lilacs coexist with the rainforest canopy.

views.label: smaller-tropical-island
views.notes: Lower coastal view clearly shows compact rainforest with interspersed cherry foliage, a narrow dry mangrove margin, submerged mangrove band and shallow outer water. Far-side detail remains naturally fog-limited; exact widths/radius are covered by generation tests.

rejected_captures.reason: Camera at Y255 was outside the useful render-distance view of the terrain; replaced by lower coastal capture. This is a rejected QA viewpoint, not a terrain failure.

limitations: Screenshots demonstrate selected geometry and rendering; numerical dimensions, counts, lighting, population persistence and collision are checked separately by GameTests.
